senses.gloss:
प्लु प्लु, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To swim, Rām. 2, 69, 9.
 2. To navigate, MBh. 3, 12782.
 3. To fly, 3, 11767.
 4. To jump, Śāk. d. 7; Rām. 5, 2, 34 (प्लवन्त्, ptcple. of the pres. Par., perhaps A monkey).
 5. To jump over (with acc.), Rām. 1, 1, 70.
 6. To blow, MBh. 3, 11070.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. प्लुत.
 1. Bathed, Chr. 46, 25; wet, Pañc. 206, 24.
 2. Jumped.
 3. Lengthened to three moras, Man. 2, 125. n.
 1. Leaping, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 12.
 2. Bounding, Lass. 27, 1; capering, one of a horse's paces. Frequent. पोप्लूय, To swim swiftly, Rām. 2, 95, 10.
 --Caus. प्लावय,
 1. To inundate, Rājat. 5, 269.
 2. To sprinkle, Pañc. 208, 12.
 3. Ātm. To bathe, Rām. 1, 44, 56.
 4. To cause to stagger. प्लावित, Moistened, Pañc. 122, 24; covered (with blood), 237, 17.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिप्लुत,
 1. Overflowed.
 2. Attacked, Hit. iv. d. 87 (v. r. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 936).
 3. Labouring, Man. 4, 41.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To cover, MBh. 3, 2016. समभिप्लुत, Overwhelmed, labouring, Man. 4, 42.
 --With अव अव, To spring down, MBh. 4, 1260.
 2. To deviate, 2, 1452.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To bathe, Man. 5, 77.
 2. To wash, MBh. 3, 8514.
 3. To swim near, 8. 12098.
 4. To [] leap on, Johns. Sel. 31, 50. आप्लुत,
 1. Bathed, Johns. Sel. 41, 49.
 2. Wetted, Pañc. 238, 23; 160, 4 (covered, viz. with blood).
 3. Covered, MBh. 3, 10693. m. An initiated householder. n. Bathing.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to bathe, MBh. 1, 7334.
 2. Ātm. To bathe (गात्राणि, one's own limbs), Chr. 46, 29.
 3. To sprinkle, Man. 3, 244.
 4. To inundate, Man. 11, 97.
 5. To cause to move, to excite, Rām. 1, 16, 24.
 --With समा सम्-आ, समाप्लुत,
 1. Drenched, drowned.
 2. Filled, MBh. 3, 2172.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To leap up, Pañc. 117, 1.
 2. To spring on, Man. 8, 236. उत्प्लुत, Jumped upon, approached suddenly.
 --With उप उप, उपप्लुत,
 1. Wet.
 2. Covered, Rām. 2, 7, 16.
 3. Assailed, Man. 4, 118.
 4. Distressed, MBh. 3, 2025.
 5. Eclipsed.
 6. Marked by prodigies.
 --With परि परि, To fluctuate, throb, Utt. Rāmac. 171, 5. परिप्लुत,
 1. Circumfused, Chr. 30, 37.
 2. Bathed.
 3. Immersed.
 --With अभिपरि अभि-परि, अभिपरि-प्लुत,
 1. Overflowed.
 2. Filled, Rām. 1, 73, 27.
 3. Agitated, Chr. 17, 29.
 --With वि वि, To fluctuate, Hit. iii. d. 2. विप्लुत,
 1. Immersed, Rājat. 5, 20.
 2. Mixed.
 3. Having had sexual intercourse, Man. 8, 377.
 4. Interrupted, Chr. 7, 21; troubled, Chr. 35, 7.
 5. Depraved, false, Utt. Rāmac. 104, 7.
 6. Devastated, destroyed, Bhāg. P. 2, 6, 40.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. to divulge, to profane, Man. 11, 198.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To flow together, Utt. Rāmac. 97, 14.
 2. To fluctuate, Utt. Rāmac. 155, 9. संप्लुत, Overspread, Johns. Sel. 60, 188.
 --Caus. To inundate, Rām. 1, 44, 35.
 --Cf. πλέω, πλεύσομαι, πλύνω, πύελος [] probably λούω; Lat. pluere, plorare, fluere, probably lavare; O.H.G. flawjan, fluz; A.S. fleot; O.H.G. fliuzan; A.S. fleowan, aet-flowan, fleotan; O.H.G. flot; A.S. flód, also fleógan, fliógan, and fleón, flión.

1. प्लुष् प्लुष्, i. 1 and 4, Par. To burn (cf. प्रुष्). प्लुष्ट, Rām. 2, 79, 20; Utt. Rāmac. 15, 5.
 --With उद् उद्, To consume with fire; उत्प्लुष्ट, Ṛt. 1, 22.

2. प्लुष् प्लुष्, ii. 9, Par.
 1. † To be wet.
 2. † To sprinkle.
 3. † To fill.
 4. To burn (cf. प्रुष्).

† प्लुस् प्लुस्, i. 4, Par.
 1. To burn.
 2. To share.
